international.title: Tech failure forces hundreds of University of Melbourne students to abandon final exams mid-test
international.summary: Students left in limbo after digital platform fails during exams, with university saying ‘third-party technical partners’ likely to blame for issue Hundreds of students at the University of Melbourne were forced to abandon their final exams on Monday morning after many were unable to access the digital platform needed to begin them. Jol Scobie, a first-year student at the university, was set to take his Australian politics exam on Monday after preparing for weeks. He had initially been told earlier in the year it was going to be a hand-written essay before instructors changed the test to a digital platform. Continue reading...
